subject: ICT
title: A House in the Square
subtitle: Drawing with coloured squares
hero_picture: A girl with a laptop sitting in a green meadow, a laptop screen beside her showing a grid of small squares with a red house made of coloured squares.

sections.heading: Squares everywhere
text: Look at a graph book. It has many small squares.
We can colour some squares to make a shape.
sections.caption: Colouring squares on paper
sections.picture: A sheet of graph paper with many small squares and a child's hand colouring some squares with a red crayon.

sections.heading: Choose a colour
text: Click on a colour on the left side.
Then click on a square. It gets that colour!
sections.caption: Colours and squares on screen
sections.picture: A laptop screen showing a grid of small squares over a green field and a row of colour buttons on the left side.

sections.heading: Draw a house
text: Colour squares in a line for the walls.
Make a triangle on top for the roof.
Leave a gap for the door!
sections.caption: A house of squares
sections.picture: A simple house shape made of red squares on a grid: a triangle roof and a square body with a door.

sections.heading: If it goes wrong
text: Did you colour a wrong square?
Then click the square to clean it.
sections.caption: Fixing a mistake
sections.picture: A child clicking a small eraser button on a laptop to remove a wrong coloured square on a grid.

sections.heading: Draw more
text: Try a tree, a boat or a flower.
sections.caption: More square pictures
sections.picture: A laptop screen grid showing a tree and a boat made of coloured squares, a happy cat watching.

rhyme: One square, two squares, red and blue,
Click a colour, click it too,
Walls and roof and a little door,
A square house, I'll draw some more!
activity: Take a graph book. Colour squares to make a house, a tree and a sun.
talk: How did we draw the house?
What do we click to fix a mistake?
What else can you draw with squares?
summary: We can click a colour and then click squares to draw pictures like a house.

questions.prompt: What do we click first to colour a square?
questions.explanation: First choose a colour, then click the square.

questions.prompt: Which shape makes the roof of the house?
questions.explanation: The roof is shaped like a triangle.

questions.prompt: What do we use to fix a wrong square?
questions.explanation: The eraser cleans a wrong square.

questions.prompt: A graph book has many small...
questions.explanation: A graph book is full of small squares.

questions.prompt: Which can we also draw with squares?
questions.explanation: We can draw a tree, a boat and more.
